transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I'm really struggling with how my skin looks, especially these terrible acne scars on my face that completely ruin my appearance. It causes me so much anxiety, even though everyone else keeps telling me it's barely noticeable. I just can't stop worrying about how awful it looks.
How much time each day do you spend thinking about your skin, and do you find yourself repeatedly checking mirrors, comparing your appearance, or trying to hide the scars?

I easily spend three or four hours every day obsessing over it, and I'm constantly checking every mirror I pass to see how bad it looks. I also find myself always comparing my skin to everyone else, and I spend a really long time using heavy makeup to try and hide these awful scars before I can even leave the house.
Besides worrying about your skin, have you been feeling down most days or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really been feeling down or lost interest in my hobbies. My main issue is just how incredibly stressed and anxious I get about how terrible my skin looks. It's really just these scars that are ruining everything for me.
Apart from your skin, do you also have unwanted repetitive thoughts or rituals about other things, like contamination, checking, counting, or needing things to feel just right?

No, I don't really have those kinds of thoughts or rituals. I don't worry about things like germs, counting, or needing objects to be arranged perfectly. My anxiety is really just focused on my face and how my skin looks.
How much is this affecting your daily life—for example, do you avoid social situations, work, school, dating, or leaving the house because of your skin?
I'm not entirely sure, and I haven't really thought about it in those terms. I mostly just focus a huge amount of my energy on hiding my skin flaws with makeup before I can go out.
Because of your skin concerns, have you ever skipped work or school, canceled plans, avoided dating or being seen in public, or stayed home until your makeup felt good enough?

Yes, I've canceled plans with my friends many times and frequently run late because I'm stuck trying to hide my skin. I spend hours putting on makeup, and if it doesn't look absolutely perfect, I feel like I cannot be seen in public. There are definitely days when I just stay home because of it.
